prompt: During World War I, the French designed a new military decoration to recognize French and allied soldiers for their service. The sculptor who designed the medal also worked on two war monuments one year after WWI ended. What is the name of the monument that he began work on, but was completed by someone else?
answer:
The monument was the **Monument à la Gloire des Armées françaises de 1914–1918** (“Monument to the Glory of the French Armies of 1914–1918”) at the Trocadéro in Paris.  

The original project was begun by **Louis-Henri Bouchard**, but the monument was ultimately redesigned and completed by **Paul Landowski**, and inaugurated in 1956.
